author: Image Science and Analysis Laboratory, NASA-Johnson Space Center.

title: File:ISS-57_Chernobyl_Nuclear_Power_Plant,_Ukraine.jpg
caption: The Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant and the Pripyat River in the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, photographed from the International Space Station, 14 October 2018.
alt: Seen from orbit, a power plant complex with a large arched shelter stands beside a cooling pond and a winding river through flat wetland.
author: NASA

title: File:2026-03-03_14-43-41_-_Meaux_-_Vue_d'ensemble.jpg
caption: The Marne at Meaux, with the town hall, the savings bank building and the Cathedral of Saint-Étienne, 3 March 2026.
alt: A river wall in the foreground, ornate nineteenth-century civic buildings with slate roofs, and a Gothic cathedral tower behind them, under a blue sky.
author: Baidax

title: File:Dnieper_River_(MODIS_2018-09-24).jpg
caption: The Dnieper River across Ukraine to the Black Sea, photographed by NASA's Terra satellite, 19 September 2018.
alt: Satellite view of brown and green farmland crossed by a broad river with reservoirs, reaching a dark sea near a peninsula and an inland sea.
author: MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

title: Crew Earth Observations (CEO) taken during Expedition 8
caption: Kyiv on the Dnieper River, photographed by an Expedition 8 crew member from the International Space Station, 4 April 2004.
alt: A gray city spreads along a winding river between two long reservoirs, surrounded by fields and dark forest.
author: NASA Johnson Space Center (Expedition 8 crew)

title: File:Bahnhof_Berlin-Hohenschönhausen_Regionalbahn.jpg
caption: The regional-train platform of Berlin-Hohenschönhausen station in Neu-Hohenschönhausen, Berlin, 10 September 2022.
alt: Two railway tracks under overhead wires run between side platforms toward a footbridge with stair towers under a clear blue sky.
author: Lukas Beck

title: File:Port-au-Prince_Haiti_2008.JPG
caption: A view over Port-au-Prince, Haiti, from the headquarters building of the UN Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH), 16 September 2008.
alt: Houses and trees on a hillside in the foreground give way to a wide city on the plain and the sea under a cloudy sky.
author: U.S. Navy photo by Chief Mass Communication Specialist James G. Pinsky

title: File:Sea_of_Azov_and_Syvash_Lake_(MODIS_2019-08-04).jpg
caption: The Sea of Azov, with the Crimean Peninsula to its west and Ukraine to its north, photographed by NASA's Terra satellite, 2 July 2019.
alt: Satellite view of green-brown steppe crossed by a river and a reservoir, above a peninsula, pink lagoons and a shallow greenish sea.
author: MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

title: File:International_Criminal_Court_2022.jpg
caption: The buildings of the International Criminal Court on the Oude Waalsdorperweg in The Hague, 6 August 2022.
alt: A tall glass tower with green plantings on its facade rises behind dry grass, beside lower white buildings with gridded windows.
author: Choinowski

title: File:Iran_BMNG.png
caption: Iran in a satellite image from NASA's Blue Marble Next Generation series, January 2004.
alt: Brown mountains and deserts between a dark inland sea at the top and a gulf below, with snow on western ranges and faint border lines.
author: NASA

title: File:Центральное_агентство_АО_«Казахтелеком»_в_г.Павлодаре.jpg
caption: The central agency building of Kazakhtelecom in Pavlodar, Kazakhstan, 14 April 2012.
alt: A white four-story corner building with a Kazakhtelecom sign and a communications mast on the roof, with two cars parked in front.
author: Меридианец

title: File:ISS044-E-457_-_View_of_Ukraine.jpg
caption: Mariupol, Ukraine, photographed from the International Space Station during Expedition 44, 13 June 2015.
alt: A hazy overhead view of a coastal city with dense streets, a port and industrial works beside a pale sea.
author: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center

title: File:Moore_County_Courthouse_on_a_rainy_day.jpg
caption: The Moore County Courthouse in its traffic circle on Highway 27 in Carthage, North Carolina, 23 July 2017.
alt: A three-story stone courthouse behind large trees and a white obelisk, seen across a wet road on a rainy day.
author: DrStew82

title: File:Southern_Bug_under_ice.JPG
caption: The Southern Bug under ice at Namyv, Mykolaiv, 24 February 2008.
alt: Broken ice floats on a wide river, with open water at left and apartment blocks and trees on the far shore.
author: Александр Андрейко

title: File:Supreme_Court_of_the_Russian_Federation.jpg
caption: The main building of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, at the corner of Povarskaya Street and Bolshoy Rzhevsky Lane, Moscow, 16 May 2010.
alt: A tall cream-colored building with columns and arched windows stands on a street corner with traffic lights and a crosswalk.
author: Stas Lobov

title: File:Palace_of_Nations_Geneva_20102014_02.jpg
caption: The Palais des Nations in Geneva, 20 October 2014.
alt: A large pale stone building with tall pillars faces a courtyard of lawns and paving, with a modern tower behind.
author: Vassil

title: File:Shetland_Islands_ESA23763941.jpg
caption: The Shetland Islands in a Copernicus Sentinel-2 image of 1 July 2021, released by the European Space Agency.
alt: A green and brown archipelago of long islands in a dark blue sea streaked with turquoise swirls, with cloud at the lower right.
author: European Space Agency; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021)

title: File:Dnieper_River_(MODIS_2018-09-24).jpg
caption: Ukraine along the middle and lower Dnieper River, photographed by NASA's Terra satellite, 19 September 2018.
alt: Satellite view of brown and green plains crossed by a river with long reservoirs, running down to a dark sea and a peninsula.
author: MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC

title: File:Satellite_image_of_Burkina_Faso_in_November_2002.jpg
caption: Burkina Faso in a NASA MODIS satellite image, 25 November 2002.
alt: Satellite view of dry tan plains in the north grading to greener land in the south, with faint border lines and a few rivers.
author: Jacques Descloitres, MODIS Rapid Response Team, NASA/GSFC

title: iss063e081399
caption: City lights of Pakistan and northern India at night, photographed from the International Space Station over Afghanistan, 31 August 2020.
alt: At night, city lights spread over a plain beside dark, cloud-streaked mountains, under a starry sky framed by parts of the space station.
author: NASA Johnson Space Center (Expedition 63 crew)

title: File:Enercon_Verwaltung.jpg
caption: The administration building of Enercon in Aurich, Lower Saxony, 9 April 2010.
alt: A red-brick office building with orange tiled gables stands behind trees and a road, with a wind turbine rising behind it.
author: Matthias Süßen
